fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the road in both approach directions.
• Keep at least one access point clear of parked vehicles at all times so emergency vehicles can enter without repositioning.
• Identify and mark the widest access point as the primary entry for emergency vehicles.
• Clear a dedicated forward pull-through or turnaround area within the access drive so emergency vehicles do not have to back out onto the road.
• Trim landscaping along the access drive so it does not narrow the drivable width or obstruct the sightlines of an approaching driver.
• Keep landscaped areas adjacent to the access drive free of low-hanging branches that could obstruct tall emergency vehicles such as fire apparatus.
• Post a simple diagram at the driveway entrance showing the layout of access points to help responders quickly identify routes to all sides of the structure.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin trees within the scattered cluster closest to any structures to increase open space between the trees and the building.
• Remove low-hanging branches from scattered trees near the structure to reduce the path fire could take from the ground into the tree canopy.
• Keep open terrain areas between tree clusters and structures free of accumulated dead leaves, branches, and other dry plant material.
